scope: Website model, validation, sharing, exports and fixed-policy stress

checks.name: Default website result matches the hand-checked sample
Demand scaling does not mutate the source; quantities remain whole units
High demand preserves material, capacity, budget and assembly feasibility
Zero budget leaves all three policies with no purchases
Untrusted URL values are ignored; oversized, fractional and negative controls rejected
Fixed-policy stress is reproducible and retains the original purchases
Stress outcomes cannot reprocure after committed chips fail to arrive
Budget points include zero and the requested budget without duplicates
CSV exports escape formula text and embedded quotes
